Subject: 20% off the Ridgeline 2P — ships today, offer ends Sunday
Preview: Your next trip just got a little lighter on the wallet. 2.1 kg tent, 20% off.
Body: Planning a trip before the season closes out? Now's a good time to pick up the shelter.

The Northbay Ridgeline 2P (NB-TNT-02) is a straightforward 3-season tent built for two. Ripstop nylon construction, 2.1 kg packed weight, and a capacity that's honest — two people with gear, not two people plus a wishful third. It's rated for spring through fall conditions; not built for winter expeditions or sustained alpine storms.

For the next few days, it's 20% off — and if you order today, it ships today.

Offer ends Sunday.
